remarks: Welcome to this fully renovated, two-bedroom, one-bath accessory apartment offering approximately 1,300 square feet of comfortable, private living in the heart of Westport. Enjoy the ease of one-level living with no stairs to navigate, a private entrance, and inviting outdoor space. Freshly painted interiors feature wood-style flooring and recessed lighting throughout. The renovated kitchen offers stainless steel appliances, stone countertops, and direct outdoor access, while the updated full bath features designer tile and a tub/shower combination. Two bedrooms, a separate living area, and a spacious 21' x 15' family room provide plenty of room to spread out. A cozy fireplace, mini-split air conditioning, and sliding doors to the outdoors make the family room an inviting place to relax. An in-unit laundry/mudroom adds everyday convenience, and the private ground-level deck overlooks a green backyard, perfect for morning coffee or unwinding at the end of the day. Ideally located just minutes from Saugatuck's shops and restaurants, Metro-North, I-95, and Westport's beaches and schools.
